title: "Team"

<!-- Machinery. Edit _content/people.yml instead of this file. -->

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helpers.R")
cfg    <- read_data("settings.yml")$people
people <- read_data("people.yml")
has    <- function(g) length(Filter(function(p) identical(p$group, g), people)) > 0
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
eyebrow(cfg$pi_heading %||% "Lead")
people_block(group = "pi")

if (has("member")) {
  eyebrow(cfg$members_heading %||% "Team")
  people_block(group = "member")
}

if (has("alumni")) {
  rule()
  eyebrow(cfg$alumni_heading %||% "Alumni")
  alumni_block()
}

if (has("collaborator")) {
  rule()
  eyebrow(cfg$collaborators_heading %||% "Collaborators")
  emit(cfg$collaborators_intro)
  collaborators_block()
}
```
